Although a great deal of notational simplicity has been gained by condensing the system of Equations 8.3 to matrix form, this does not alter the fact that the solution of a large system of simultaneous equations is a tedious task if performed by hand. Today, such solutions are rapidly accomplished on computers. Before considering matrix methods in more detail, we present an application of Equation 8.1 to quantitative genetics.
